# Alex Miller Real Estate Auctions – Central Kansas

> Central Kansas's trusted licensed real estate auctioneer delivering transparent, competitive auctions for residential, land, and commercial properties — serving Wichita, El Dorado, Andover, Hutchinson, Salina, and communities across south-central Kansas.
